title: Machi Koro-style round factory category icon spec
purpose: A new blue factory-category badge placed immediately before the Pivzavod card title.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the icon asset for card compositing.
integration_context.composition: one centered circular badge filling most of the square canvas

icon_color.description: Dark blue matching the blue card footer.

subject.default: factory silhouette with three smokestacks and smoke
subject.description: A bold white industrial factory pictogram.

badge_geometry.outer_margin: genuinely transparent margin around the circle

pictogram.subject: factory silhouette with exactly three smokestacks and three simple smoke puffs
pictogram.description: A centered solid white silhouette: low blocky factory roofline, exactly three vertical smokestacks of slightly varied height, and one chunky rounded smoke puff above each stack. Front-facing and instantly readable.
pictogram.shape_language: very simple, chunky, geometric, slightly rounded
pictogram.line_rule: Solid white silhouette or a few thick connected white shapes; no thin line art.

visual_style.core: Flat two-color Machi Koro category badge.
visual_style.small_size_priority: instantly recognizable beside a card title

anti_patterns: do not omit the dark-blue circle
do not add an outer ring
do not use gradients or shadows
do not add text, letters, numbers, logos, or scenery
do not use more or fewer than three smokestacks

current_icon.subject: front-facing factory silhouette with exactly three smoking smokestacks
current_icon.expected_result: A dark-blue solid circle with a bold white three-stack factory pictogram on a genuinely transparent canvas.

final_prompt_summary: Generate only a small Machi Koro-style category badge on a genuinely transparent square canvas. Make one perfect solid circle in #0D3F78 filling about 85% of the canvas. Center a bold pure-white silhouette of a low factory with exactly three vertical smokestacks and one simple rounded smoke puff above each stack. The pictogram fills about 54% of the circle. Flat two-color vector-style artwork only: no border, text, letters, numbers, logo, shading, gradient, texture, shadow, 3D effect, scenery, or background.
